[[Black demon]]s can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at 80 [[combat level]] by various [[Slayer master]]s. They can be found in a variety of [[List of dungeons|dungeons]] around [[Gielinor]]. Black demons can be easily killed using [[safespot]]s when attacking with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]], or by using [[melee]] with the [[Protect from Melee]] [[prayer]]. They are weak to [[demonbane weapons]], as well as [[water spells]].

For lower-levelled players, black demon tasks can be very daunting, as their high stats requires safespotting, which will significantly lower kill rates. Higher-levelled players will not have this problem, but the demons have a near non-existent drop table which makes killing them generally not worth the time or experience. 

The two best spots for killing black demons would be [[Taverley Dungeon]] or the [[Chasm of Fire]]. The former has many demons packed together while the latter has more safespots, and both are cannonable. The advantage of the latter is that those who have completed [[A Kingdom Divided]] and signed a contract with [[Yama]] will be able to get contracts from killing the demons. The drop rate is increased when killing them according to preference, but catering to this will prolong tasks and reduce AFK time. While black demons are also found in the [[Catacombs of Kourend]], which is a [[multicombat area]] and have access to the catacombs table, it is generally not worth killing them there as they have unusually higher Defence compared to the other variants and it is not possible to utilise all four spawns.

In the Wilderness, black demons are only found in two locations; [[Edgeville Dungeon]] and the [[Wilderness Slayer Cave]]. Both spots are under 30 Wilderness, though the latter is a multicombat area. Each location has their advantages; Edgeville Dungeon is easier to escape from, while the Wilderness Slayer Cave is multicombat, has a different drop table, and has one entrance, with hopping inside being slightly difficult due to the demons' aggression.

If the player is killing black demons that were assigned to them by any Slayer master other than [[Krystilia]] or [[Konar quo Maten|Konar]], they may choose to kill [[demonic gorilla]]s instead. This requires completion of [[Monkey Madness II]] and two combat styles. Killing demonic gorillas is slower, though they are [[Money making guide/Killing demonic gorillas|quite profitable]].

==Exceptions==
*The [[black demon (The Grand Tree)|black demon]] defeated during The Grand Tree can be killed again in the Nightmare Zone after the quest has been completed. Killing black demons in the Nightmare Zone will count as a kill for a Slayer task.
*[[Kolodion]] can only be killed once during the Mage Arena miniquest.
